notes.title: It’s here! THE GAME OF LIFE 2 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
It’s taken iOS and Android by storm; it’s nominated for 2 TIGA Awards; it’s the official, contemporary sequel to one of the most popular board games of all time!

Set out on a new LIFE adventure, with more choices and more freedom than ever before! Updated to reflect modern values and life experiences, this time you’ll face additional big, path altering decisions further down the road, and have the chance to earn more in life than just money. Collect points for Happiness and Knowledge as well as Wealth!

Get married early and start a family, or stay single, adopt a pet, and save finding that special someone until later in life. Every decision counts! Choose to invest for Wealth points, take a trip and boost your Happiness, or go back to college and get another degree! All can lead to victory.

Available for cross-platform multiplayer gaming on Steam and mobile, you can challenge friends and family, whether they’re on PC, iOS or Android!

In THE GAME OF LIFE 2 there are so many more ways to win! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1455630/THE_GAME_OF_LIFE_2/]Play now[/url]!

[previewyoutube=5_lYGYJnpW0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Get ready, THE GAME OF LIFE 2 is coming!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33373301/ed5073f48c4731bd28896e6a91fe8f868cd0134b.png[/img]

It’s almost time to live a new LIFE on PC. The official contemporary sequel to one of the world’s most popular board games is coming soon to Steam! With more choices and more freedom than ever before, there’s a thousand new ways to live in THE GAME OF LIFE 2!

This time there’s more to winning the game than just money. Gain points for Happiness, Knowledge and Wealth, and make your choices count.

It’s multiplayer fun on PC and mobile, with cross-platform gaming. So you can challenge friends and family to a game whether they’re on PC, iPhone or Android! Will you get married or stay single? Have a baby, or adopt a pet? Be a Video Blogger, or go to college and become a Robotics Engineer? The choice is yours!

THE GAME OF LIFE 2 coming soon to Steam. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1455630/THE_GAME_OF_LIFE_2/?curator_clanid=33373301]Add to your wishlist today[/url]!

notes.title: Online multiplayer comes to THE GAME OF LIFE: The Official 2016 Edition in Update 3
notes.content:
The third update of [b]THE GAME OF LIFE: The Official 2016 Edition[/b] introduces two exciting new features and a host of bug fixes.

Update 3 allows you to play THE GAME OF LIFE in a whole new way; via online multiplayer. Match with other players or invite your Steam friends to play against you as you race to the final yellow square.

Here’s a breakdown of the new features included in Update 3:
[list]
    [*]Online multiplayer
    [*]Invite Steam friends to play online
    [*]Bug fixes
[/list]
As always we are committed to making THE GAME OF LIFE the very best board game adaptation available on Steam, and now, with this update, you’ll be able to spin the wheel and enjoy this constantly improving game with more people than ever before.

More updates are in the works so please continue to let us know what you would like to see in THE GAME OF LIFE and we’ll try our best to include the best suggestions.

Dean Samways 
Community Manager 
Marmalade Technologies

notes.title: THE GAME OF LIFE: The Official 2016 Edition gets Update 2!
notes.content:
[b]THE GAME OF LIFE is receiving its second update in under a week as Marmalade Game Studio works tirelessly to give you the best game possible.[/b]

Update 2 introduces:
[list]

We’re committed to continually improve THE GAME OF LIFE so you can continue to enjoy it over and over again with family and friends.

notes.title: Update 1 for THE GAME OF LIFE - The Official 2016 Edition is here!
notes.content:
[b]Live THE GAME OF LIFE in the all-new and improved Official 2016 Edition[/b]

Today, THE GAME OF LIFE is receiving a brand new update. Enjoy the very best playing experience on your path to success, becoming graduates, parents and millionaires along the way.

With its new modern aesthetic, simpler menu navigation and two brand new mini-games, THE GAME OF LIFE has never looked or played better. Download the latest version from Steam now to enjoy these, and the following, new features.

Update 1 also includes:
[list]
    [*]‘Grab the Cash’ and ‘Statues’ mini-games
    [*]New Player Selection Menu
    [*]Enhanced user interface 
    [*]New keyboard controls - Press Space to spin the wheel!
    [*]Improved tutorials and feedback text
[/list]
Progressing through THE GAME OF LIFE, one tile, one milestone at a time, has never been more fun!

Download the latest version of THE GAME OF LIFE from Steam [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/403120]here[/url].

Let us know what you think of the improvements, but for now, spin the wheel and win big at THE GAME OF LIFE!

Dean Samways 
Community Manager 
Marmalade Technologies

notes.title: Game Of Life Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Hello Game of Life players,

We want to take this opportunity to thank you all for your patience as we update The Game of Life - Official 2016 Edition.

Your comments and feedback are being heard and improvements implemented in the ongoing game development pipeline. Your continued input and our ongoing work will deliver the best Game of Life experience possible on Steam in the very near future.

Please keep sending us your thoughts via the discussion boards and we will continue to listen.

We’re planning to release an updated version of Game of Life very soon and of course our Steam community will be the first to know when that lands.

Until then, please continue to enjoy The Game of Life - Official 2016 Edition and keep your comments coming.

Dean Samways
Community Manager
Marmalade Technologies
